question: Identify the sentence with an error in the use of simple present tense.

options.text: He go to school every day.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. "He go to school every day".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **"He go to school every day"** contains an error in the use of the **simple present tense**.
